verses.saheeh: Have you seen the one who denies the Judgement?
verses.khattab: Have you seen the one who denies the ˹final˺ Judgment
verses.jalalayn: Have you seen him who denies the Judgement?, the Requital and the Reckoning, that is to say, ‘Do you know who he is?’ If you do not know him then:
verses.romanUrdu: Tum ne dekha us shaks ko jo aakhirat ki jaza va saza ko jhutlata hai

verses.saheeh: For that is the one who drives away the orphan
verses.khattab: That is the one who repulses the orphan
verses.jalalayn: ﻿That is he (read an implied huwa after the fā’ [of fa-dhālika]) who repels the orphan, that is to say, [who] violently drives him away from what is his due,
verses.romanUrdu: Wahi to hai jo yateem ko dhakkey deta hai

verses.indopak: وَ لَا يَحُضُّ عَلٰى طَعَامِ الْمِسْكِيْنِ ۗ
verses.saheeh: And does not encourage the feeding of the poor.
verses.khattab: and does not encourage the feeding of the poor
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and does not urge, either himself or others [to], the feeding of the needy: this was revealed regarding al-‘Āsī b. Wā’il or al-Walīd b. al-Mughīra.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur miskeen ka khana dene par nahin uksata

verses.saheeh: So woe to those who pray
verses.khattab: So woe to those ˹hypocrites˺ who pray
verses.romanUrdu: Phir tabahi hai un namaz padhne walon ke liye

verses.saheeh: [But] who are heedless of their prayer -
verses.khattab: yet are unmindful of their prayers
verses.jalalayn: ﻿those who are heedless of their prayers, neglectful, delaying them from their appointed times,
verses.romanUrdu: Jo apni namaz se gaflat barat-tey hain

verses.saheeh: Those who make show [of their deeds]
verses.jalalayn: ﻿those who make a pretence, with prayers and otherwise,

verses.khattab: and refuse to give ˹even the simplest˺ aid
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and deny aid, as [insignificant as] a needle, a hatchet, a cooking pot or a bowl.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur maamuli zarurat ki cheezen (logon ko) dene se gurez karte hai
